# Auxiliary gas tank installation

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Install an auxiliary gas tank by welding mounting plates, bolting a cage, and plumbing lines with a splitter. [t68]

## Parts

- [Partial] Ametometer Digital Fuel Gauge (6310) [t68]
- Chevy Blazer, 2002 Fuel Tank (GM18D) [t68]
- Fuel Module/Pump Assembly (SP414M) [t68]
- Raw Splitter or Y Fitting [t68]
- Strap Set for Tank (ST122) [t68]

## Tips & gotchas

- Use a splitter fitting to fill both the OEM and auxiliary tanks simultaneously at fuel stations. [t68]
- Add an LED blocker film over the Autometer gauge if it dims under headlights or flashes when fuel drops below 10%. [t68]
- Turn off the transfer switch when the gauge reads 0% to avoid running the pump dry. [t68]
